title: How to get a Google Gemini API key—and use the Gemini API
summary: This Gemini API guide will help you understand what Gemini can do, how to get a Gemini API key, and how to set up the API calls to start talking to it.
body_markdown:
**Free plan (Google AI Studio)**


**Pay-as-you-go plan (Paid or Enterprise)**


Price


Free for Gemini 3.x and Omni series models


Most powerful Gemini 4 Carbon at $4 input, $20 output (per million tokens). Varies based on the size of the prompt and model used; pay less for inputs but more for outputs


Data privacy


Prompts and responses may be used by Google to train future models


Data isn't used to train Google models


Rate limits


Limited across requests per minute (RPM), tokens per minute (TPM), and requests per day (RPM), depending on model


Varies per model; tier-based options that progressively unlock higher rate limits depending on previous usage, billing tier cap, or contract terms for enterprise plans
